title: Bram and the Spire
author: Hazel Thackeray
blurb: August Iversen, the youngest member of a dying guild, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown before the last dragon-fire gutters out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
